stories.headline: Prime Minister Mark Carney calls six federal by-elections for December

The vote will give the governing Liberals an opportunity to strengthen their thin majority in the House of Commons while providing the opposition with a key test of leadership.

stories.summary: British Columbia, Alberta, Manitoba, northwestern Ontario, and the Northwest Territories have officially opted to stay on daylight time year-round. Parents and businesses in the affected regions are adjusting to the long-awaited change as the twice-annual clock adjustments end.

stories.summary: U.S. defence and aerospace giant Lockheed Martin has acquired Nova Scotia-based undersea warfare company Ultra Maritime for $3.45 billion. The major transaction highlights continued foreign investment and consolidation within Canada's defence sector.
